# Нагрузочный контур API: стоимость, bulk, webhooks

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P14/phase.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Design

detailed

## Goal

RAG:— P13 даёт shared invoker/profile; P5 outbox/inbox; P12 observer/error descriptor.
В transfer уже есть batch transaction/fence, но нет cancellation/enforced time/memory,
public export port и generic job factory. Экспорт unsealed не resumable — restart
новым manifest; импорт возобновляется с committed checkpoint (D78).
RAG:✅ Perplexity и direct primary-source verification подтвердили requested/actual
cost pattern, LRO partial cancellation, Standard Webhooks bytes/rotation и SSRF controls.
Все CoreX defaults и SQL algorithms — решения D74–D84, не vendor guarantees.

> **Контракт фазы.** Производит operation-cost/1, bulk-operation/1 и webhook-delivery/1
> поверх P13, сохраняя D9: transfer — единственный двигатель чтения/записи/экспорта.
> Новых runtime dependencies, GraphQL, generic CRUD и multi-tenant relay scheduler нет.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: security-external
> Integration Seams: operation-invoker · shared-budget-db · tenant-db · transfer-checkpoint · outbox-inbox · outbound-http · signing-secrets · snapshots
> Live or Irreversible: yes
> Audit Intent: direct-close-eligible
> Rationale: Deployment способен отправлять необратимые webhook effects; execution
> ограничено synthetic secrets/local receivers. G-DDL P14.3, G-SECRET P14.19; full
> item review, signing/SSRF/rotation security-review; live rollout не авторизован.

## P14 — Нагрузочный контур API: стоимость, bulk, webhooks



## Phase Context

RAG:— P13 даёт shared invoker/profile; P5 outbox/inbox; P12 observer/error descriptor.
В transfer уже есть batch transaction/fence, но нет cancellation/enforced time/memory,

Все CoreX defaults и SQL algorithms — решения D74–D84, не vendor guarantees.

> **Контракт фазы.** Производит operation-cost/1, bulk-operation/1 и webhook-delivery/1
> поверх P13, сохраняя D9: transfer — единственный двигатель чтения/записи/экспорта.
> Новых runtime dependencies, GraphQL, generic CRUD и multi-tenant relay scheduler нет.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: security-external
> Integration Seams: operation-invoker · shared-budget-db · tenant-db · transfer-checkpoint · outbox-inbox · outbound-http · signing-secrets · snapshots
> Live or Irreversible: yes

## DoR

- [x] Q4 закрыт D75: observe ancestors, global enforce; отсутствие store не fail-open.
- [x] DDL/secret gates названы, grants не предполагаются.
- [x] SSRF pin-before-connect, replay identity, PII и retention зафиксированы.
- [x] Export resume исправлен по коду; public optional adapter boundary объявлен.
- [x] Каждый item имеет нормативный параграф, ≤8 Files, ≤14 Required Reads.
- [ ] Execution: все predecessor phases terminal, D14 stage-2 audit закрыт.
- [ ] G-DDL и G-SECRET разрешены до соответствующих gated items.

## Scope Included

Compiled cost recipes/pure estimator; shared SQL hierarchical reservation/refund;
observe/enforce/default global safety; HTTP/tool cost parity; bulk store/submit/poll/
cancel/result/failures; optional public transfer adapter, import resume/export restart,
cooperative cancellation/time/memory/source limits; declared webhook topics and PII;
transactional fan-out, immutable delivery bytes/id; signing/rotation; pinned HTTPS
SSRF policy; fenced retry/dead/history/replay; retention; typed wiring; snapshot gates;
package qualification, docs and single root changelog.

## Scope Excluded

GraphQL; billing; hard real-time preemption; universal exactly-once/ordering;
second transfer engine; arbitrary connector/factory discovery; remote test sends;
production migration/rollback, live secret rotation, deployment/tag/split publication;
P15 renames and P16 moves; generic cross-account scheduler (D48).

## Dependencies

Execution requires terminal P4, P5, P7, P11, P12, P13 and stage-2 audit (D14).
Each item Inputs pins its direct predecessor carriers; their product outputs must
exist at execution. All branches join P14.19 → P14.20 → P14.21.
Recommended B23=P14.1→P14.2; B24=P14.4→P14.5; B25=P14.7→P14.8;
B26=P14.11→P14.12; B27=P14.15→P14.16. Gated P14.3/P14.19 remain solo.
Design does not mark items done, materialize future bundles or grant owner authority.

## Validation

Full acceptance/threat matrix: @plan/knowledge/research-P14-design.json §14. SQLite behavior and isolated
PostgreSQL concurrency, synthetic keys and local TLS receiver; production URL denial
policy separately tested. Root lint/analyse/test plus affected package lanes, P3 BC/
package graph and P8 provider ratchets, P13/P14 snapshot planted failures.
Skipped/unavailable checks stay non-green. Independent security review applies to
P14.13/P14.14 and rotation wiring, not blanket phase-audit authority.

## Phase Handoff

Execution receipt records schema/profile hashes, budgets/refunds, bulk crash/cancel,
export restart, SSRF and rotation vectors, retry/replay/retention, PG/local-only proof,
owner grants and any skipped checks. Current invocation delivers design only.
